Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 151. Category: technique. “Other” Ki Techniques.

Rank 2 melee technique
Ki Cost: 25 ki
Casting Time: 1 action
Prerequisites: None
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Melee
Chargeable?: No
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: blast
A lightning quick flurry of strikes followed by an even
faster energy beam. Roll 2 combo attack rolls, dealing
your unarmed strike damage die on a hit and then roll a
Blast attack roll that deals 6d6 force damage on a hit.
You end this technique 15 feet above the target.
